modules.name: OpenLadderStudio.Core
owns: PLC platform contracts, controller capabilities, memory addressing, universal ladder model
ladder scan engine, virtual process image, simulated plant library and synoptic scene model

modules.name: OpenLadderStudio.Application
owns: use-case orchestration, project workflows, controller selection, validation

modules.name: OpenLadderStudio.Drivers.Modbus
owns: Modbus communication, polling, bulk reads, trend history

modules.name: OpenLadderStudio.Drivers.TP02
owns: TP02 framing, program reading, decoding and protocol-specific compatibility

modules.name: OpenLadderStudio.UI
owns: WinForms shell, editor, device management, dialogs and visual monitoring

migrationRules: New production code belongs under src once its target module exists.
OpenLadderStudio.Desktop remains the compatibility and legacy-build boundary until responsibilities are extracted into the target modules.
Generated .build.cs files must never be committed.
New protocol behavior is introduced through driver contracts, not through UI conditionals.
